translations.web: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to Yahweh, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.
translations.bsb: When you sacrifice a thank offering to the LORD, offer it so that it may be acceptable on your behalf.
translations.kjv: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the LORD, offer it at your own will.
translations.asv: And when ye sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto Jehovah, ye shall sacrifice it that ye may be accepted.
